doc: GraniteMoeShared (IBM): GraniteMoE plus an optional shared expert of width shared_intermediate_size (default 0 = none). The shared expert's gate and up are fused into one tensor (shared_mlp.input_linear), which the binder cannot slice yet (FR-01), so this adapter claims the family only for shared_intermediate_size = 0 and REFUSES otherwise, naming FR-01. Third-party adapter (lane H): data only, extends the built-in granitemoe.

$check: shared_intermediate_size > 0: the shared expert's gate and up are one fused tensor, which needs weights as data (FR-01)
